1.text: Nuko abwira abigishwa be ati “Nta cyabuza ibisitaza kuza, ariko ubizana azabona ishyano.

2.text: Ibyamubera byiza ni uko yahambirwa urusyo mu ijosi akarohwa mu nyanja, biruta ko yagusha umwe muri aba batoya.

3.text: Mwirinde!“Mwene so nakora nabi umucyahe, niyihana umubabarire.

4.text: Kandi nakugirira nabi ku munsi umwe, akaguhindukirira karindwi ati ‘Ndihannye’, uzamubabarire.”

5.text: Maze intumwa zibwira Umwami Yesu ziti “Twongerere kwizera.”

6.text: Umwami ati “Mwagira kwizera kungana n'akabuto ka sinapi, mwabwira uyu mukuyu muti ‘Randuka uterwe mu nyanja’, na wo wabumvira.

7.text: “Ariko ni nde muri mwe ufite umugaragu umuhingira cyangwa umuragirira intama, wamubwira akiva ku murimo ati ‘Igira hano vuba wicare ufungure?’

8.text: Ahubwo ntiyamubwira ati ‘Banza untunganirize ibyokurya byanjye, ukenyere umpereze kugeza ubwo ndangiza kurya no kunywa, maze hanyuma nawe ubone kurya’?

9.text: Mbese yashima uwo mugaragu kuko yakoze ibyo ategetswe?

10.text: Nuko namwe nimumara gukora ibyo mwategetswe byose mujye muvuga muti ‘Turi abagaragu batagira umumaro, kuko twashohoje gusa ibyo twabwiwe gukora.’ ”

11.text: Nuko bari mu nzira bajya i Yerusalemu, anyura hagati y'i Samariya n'i Galilaya.

12.text: Akigera mu kirorero asanganirwa n'ababembe cumi, bahagarara kure

14.text: Ababonye arababwira ati “Nimugende mwiyereke umutambyi.” Bakigenda barakira.

15.text: Umwe muri bo abonye akize agaruka ahimbaza Imana n'ijwi rirenga,

16.text: yikubita imbere y'ibirenge bye aramushima, kandi uwo yari Umusamariya.

17.text: Yesu aramubaza ati “Ntimwakize muri icumi? Ba bandi cyenda bari he?

18.text: Nta bandi bagarutse guhimbaza Imana, keretse uyu munyamahanga?”

19.text: Kandi aramubwira ati “Byuka wigendere, kwizera kwawe kuragukijije.”

20.text: Abafarisayo baramubaza bati “Ubwami bw'Imana buzaza ryari?” Arabasubiza ati “Ubwami bw'Imana ntibuzaza ku mugaragaro,

21.text: kandi ntibazavuga bati ‘Dore ngubu’, cyangwa bati ‘Nguburiya’, kuko ubwami bw'Imana buri hagati muri mwe.”

22.text: Abwira abigishwa be ati “Hazabaho igihe muzifuza kubona umunsi umwe mu minsi y'Umwana w'umuntu, ariko ntimuzawubona.

23.text: Kandi bazababwira bati ‘Dore nguriya’, cyangwa bati ‘Dore nguyu.’ Ntimuzajyeyo kandi ntimuzabakurikire.

24.text: Nk'uko umurabyo urabiriza mu ruhande rumwe rw'ijuru, ukarabagiranira mu rundi, uko ni ko Umwana w'umuntu azaba ku munsi we.

25.text: Ariko akwiriye kubanza kubabazwa uburyo bwinshi, no kwangwa n'ab'iki gihe.

26.text: Kandi uko byari biri mu minsi ya Nowa, ni ko bizaba no mu minsi y'Umwana w'umuntu:

27.text: bararyaga, baranywaga, bararongoraga, barashyingiraga, bageza umunsi Nowa yinjiriye mu nkuge, umwuzure uraza urabarimbura bose.

28.text: No mu minsi ya Loti na yo byari bimeze bityo: bararyaga, baranywaga, baraguraga, barabibaga, barubakaga,

29.text: maze umunsi Loti yavuye i Sodomu, umuriro n'amazuku biva mu ijuru biragwa, birabarimbura bose.

30.text: Ni na ko bizamera umunsi Umwana w'umuntu azabonekeraho.

31.text: “Uwo munsi uzaba hejuru y'inzu, ibintu bye bikaba biri mu nzu, ye kuzamanuka kubikuramo, n'uri mu mirima ni uko ntazasubira inyuma.

33.text: Ushaka kurengera ubugingo bwe wese azabubura, ariko uzabura ubugingo bwe wese azaburokora.

34.text: Ndababwira yuko muri iryo joro, ababiri bazaba baryamye ku buriri bumwe, umwe azajyanwa undi agasigara.

35.text: Abagore babiri bazaba basera hamwe, umwe azajyanwa undi asigare. [

36.text: Ababiri bazaba bari mu murima, umwe azajyanwa undi asigare.]”

37.text: Baramubaza bati “Databuja, bizabera he?”Arababwira ati “Aho intumbi iri hose, ni ho inkongoro ziteranira.”
